chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ :

translations.en: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from ʿAli ibn Riʾab, from Abu ʿUbaydah, from Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي امْرَأَةٍ شَرِبَتْ دَوَاءً وَ هِيَ حَامِلٌ لِتَطْرَحَ وَلَدَهَا فَأَلْقَتْ وَلَدَهَا

translations.en: Regarding a woman who drank medicine while she was pregnant in order to cast out her child, and then she miscarried her child.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ "إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَظْمٌ قَدْ نَبَتَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّحْمُ وَ شُقَّ لَهُ السَّمْعُ وَ الْبَصَرُ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهَا دِيَةً تُسَلِّمُهَا إِلَى أَبِيهِ"

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "If it had bone and flesh had grown over it, and hearing and sight had been formed for it, then a blood money is due from her, which she hands over to its father."

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ "وَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَقَةً أَوْ مُضْغَةً فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهَا أَرْبَعِينَ دِينَاراً أَوْ غُرَّةً تُسَلِّمُهَا إِلَى أَبِيهِ"

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "And if it was a clinging clot or a lump of flesh, then forty dinars or a ghurrah are due from her, which she hands over to its father."

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ فَهِيَ لَا تَرِثُ مِنْ وَلَدِهَا مِنْ دِيَتِهِ قَالَ "لَا لِأَنَّهَا قَتَلَتْهُ".

translations.en: I said: "So she does not inherit from her child from its blood money?" He عليه السلام said: "No, because she killed him."
translations.ur: میں نے کہا: "تو وہ اپنے بچے کی دیہ سے وارث نہیں بنتی؟" آپ علیہ السلام نے فرمایا: "نہیں، کیونکہ اس نے اسے مار دیا۔"
translations.tr: Dedim ki: "O, çocuğunun diyetinden miras almaz mı?" O, aleyhisselam dedi ki: "Hayır, çünkü onu öldürdü."
translations.fa: گفتم: «پس او از خون‌بهای فرزندش ارث نمی‌برد؟» حضرت علیه‌السلام فرمود: «نه، زیرا او را کشته است.»
translations.id: Saya berkata: "Jadi dia tidak mewarisi dari anaknya dari diyatnya?" Beliau علیه السلام berkata: "Tidak, karena dia membunuhnya."
translations.bn: আমি বললাম: “তাহলে সে তার সন্তানের দীয়াত থেকে উত্তরাধিকারী হয় না?” তিনি علیه السلام বললেন: “না, কারণ সে তাকে হত্যা করেছে।”
translations.es: Dije: "¿Entonces ella no hereda de su hijo de su dinero de sangre?" Él عليه السلام dijo: "No, porque ella lo mató."
translations.fr: J'ai dit : « Elle n'hérite donc pas de son enfant de son diyat ? » Il عليه السلام a dit : « Non, parce qu'elle l'a tué. »
translations.de: Ich sagte: „Erbt sie also nicht von ihrem Kind aus dessen Blutgeld?“ Er عليه السلام sagte: „Nein, weil sie es getötet hat.“
translations.ru: Я сказал: «Значит, она не наследует от своего ребенка из его дийят?» Он عليه السلام сказал: «Нет, потому что она его убила.»
translations.zh: 我说：“那么她不从她的孩子的血钱中继承吗？”他 عليه السلام说：“不，因为她杀了他。”

en.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on the blood money owed when a pregnant woman causes the loss of her fetus by taking medicine. The amount depends on the stage of fetal development, and the compensation is given to the father. It also states that the mother does not inherit from that blood money because she is the one who caused the killing.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling on blood money if a woman aborts her fetus by taking medicine?

key_terms.دِيَةً: blood money or legal compensation due for causing death
key_terms.عَلَقَةً: an early embryonic stage described as a clinging clot
key_terms.أَرْبَعِينَ دِينَاراً: forty dinars as specified financial compensation
key_terms.غُرَّةً: a prescribed form of compensation in fetal injury cases
key_terms.قَتَلَتْهُ: she killed him, which is the reason for exclusion from inheritance
